scope: User-approved return to standalone stage 2: CRSI extremes only. No ladder, live short, exit optimization, combined indicators, pulse or SR. No live changes.

entryRules.into: U=80/90/95; L=100-U. Long previous CRSI>L and current<=L; short previous<U and current>=U. Contrarian entry as extreme is reached, NOT momentum following.
entryRules.back_out: Long previous CRSI<=L and current>L; short previous>=U and current<U. Wait for recovery out of extreme. Inclusive extreme boundaries, strict exit from extreme.
entryRules.clock: Same I01 rolling 12h clock, long and short separately. Starts first 00/12 UTC at/after window start, rolls after each exit fill with specified delay. One control per side/window/delay, not duplicated per timeframe.

formula: research-features-v1-wilder-prior-rank: unrounded mean of RSI3(close), RSI2(signed consecutive-close streak), strict-less current-return rank vs PRIOR100 returns. Not legacy live CRSI.
stateRules: One crossing per completed selected timeframe bar, require previous adjacent complete bar. Ignore occupied/pending crossings, do not queue them. One position, no adds/compounding. Timeout 12h after actual entry, then declared exit delay. Minute open execution; end inventory marked at last close less hypothetical exit fee. No retrospective entry into an already-extreme start state.
timing: Fixed June1 seed and complete UTC bars from repaired minute history. Zero publication lag is a historical modeling assumption; +1m sensitivity delays both entry and timeout exit. No use of entry minute H/L/C for entry. No final-bar lookahead. Timeframes change signal clocks, never execution clock/hold.
funding: Excluded: incomplete settlement archive after April2026. After modeled trading fees, before funding; not account-net or live execution certification.
researchScreen: Same strict I01 diagnostic screen: >=30 full/10 recent closed trades; positive net AND delta vs same-side rolling clock in BOTH overlapping windows and BOTH delays; all monthly marked deltas nonnegative; positive additional5bps/side fixed-path stress net; no exhausted equity. Report individual reasons and descriptive profits even when full screen fails. Not a deployment gate or proof an indicator family is useless.
ranking: Predeclared: rank by full zero-delay dollar delta versus same-side clock, as I01. Also display all36 rules, side-specific absolute PnL, both windows/delays, trade counts, winning/losing dollars and monthly results. A weak short clock can make negative rules rank high; never substitute clock improvement for positive profit.
overlapParity: Before inspecting new cases, rerun exact 1h U80 back_out long/short and long/short clock for both windows/delays; compare full ledgers/monthly/stats to old engine AND saved I01 artifacts. 16 overlap cases, not extra hypotheses.
selectionLimit: User-approved bounded expansion after narrow prior findings; 34 new definitions plus2 repeated controls. All dates previously mined, windows overlap, thresholds nest, trades are correlated. Not untouched validation. No next sweep without discussion of these results.
